lines.zh: 用触手探索周围的腐肉
lines.en: Uses tentacles to search for flesh
Licks up blood on the ground
Emerges from a decayed tree root

lines.zh: 我用两条胳膊拖着身子爬。
lines.en: I drag myself along on both arms.

lines.zh: 断腿在碎石上蹭出血痕。
lines.en: My broken leg smears blood across the gravel.
I lie in the corner without moving.
Stays still, waiting for an opportunity
Touches the player with its tentacles

lines.zh: 向玩家发出嘶嘶声并蠕动过来
lines.en: Hisses and crawls towards the player
This third skin of mine has torn.
Dragging my skin along is agony.

lines.zh: 我的下巴卡住了，合不上。
我的腿断了，只能这么爬。
lines.en: My legs are broken; crawling is all I have.

lines.zh: 我的手臂撑不住身体了。
lines.en: My arms can no longer hold me up.
My leg is broken; I can only crawl now...
Elbows scraping the ground — closer now.

lines.zh: 食物的味道，让我爬得更快。
lines.en: The smell of food makes me crawl faster.

lines.zh: 你的血肉对我来说太珍贵了！
你手里那东西，还在滴油。
lines.en: That thing in your hand is still dripping grease.

lines.zh: 皮肤和血肉，我唯一的渴望。
lines.en: Skin and flesh, my only desire.
Fresh blood. I can smell it.

lines.zh: 我趴在地上，用两条胳膊爬。
lines.en: I drag myself along on two arms.
Your boot scrapes across my hand.
Do not touch what has fallen out of me.

lines.zh: 趴着的爬尸，被撞得打转。
lines.en: A crawling corpse sent spinning by your shove.

lines.zh: 同类的味道，在废墟那头。
lines.en: My kind's scent comes from beyond the ruins.

lines.zh: 爬着也要找个伴，牙齿都磨平了。
lines.en: Even crawling I seek a mate, my teeth worn flat.

lines.zh: 爬着也要找个伴，牙都磨平了。
lines.en: Crawling, I still want a mate, though my teeth are worn flat.

lines.zh: 这副爬着的身子，也想靠近谁。
lines.en: Even this crawling body wants to draw near someone.

lines.zh: 我拖着断腿也爬得比你快。
lines.en: Even with a broken leg I crawl faster.
I can catch you even dragging a leg.

lines.zh: 我趴在地上，手先伸过来。
lines.en: Flat on the ground, I reach out first.
A low growl squeezes out of my throat.

lines.zh: 我爬过的地方，留下湿痕。
lines.en: A wet trail marks where I have crawled.
I crawl slowly, but I never stop.
You are bleeding. Do not pretend otherwise.
I know the smell of the living.
That good leg of yours will not carry you far.
I raise my head and there you are.
I crawl low, nails scraping dirt.
I count your heels: one, two.

lines.zh: 我用指甲抠着地往前挪。
lines.en: My nails dig in and haul me forward.
My jaw hangs open, blood dripping.
You retreat; I crawl after you.

lines.zh: 喉咙里的声音断断续续。
lines.en: The sound in my throat comes in broken bursts.
I wait for you to misstep.
The distance shrinks inch by inch.

lines.zh: 我的手已经伸向你的靴子。
lines.en: My hand is already reaching for your boot.

lines.zh: 我拖着一条腿，先摸到你。
lines.en: I drag one leg and reach you anyway.

lines.zh: 拖着两条腿，专啃暖和的东西。
lines.en: Dragging both legs, I chew only what is warm.
Hold on, and you'll regret it!

lines.zh: 我一口咬在你的脚踝上。
lines.en: I sink my teeth into your ankle.

lines.zh: 我一口咬在你的小腿上！
lines.en: I sink my teeth into your calf!
My nails dig into the top of your foot!
I wrap your leg and drag you down!

lines.zh: 被咬的地方开始流血了！
我压住你的胸口，别想起来！
lines.en: I pin your chest; do not try to get up!
I tear off a strip and swallow it whole!

lines.zh: 我从土里伸手，抓住草根。
lines.en: I reach out of the soil and grip the roots.

lines.zh: 腐肉的气味把我叫醒了。
lines.en: The smell of carrion wakes me in the ground.

lines.zh: 我拖着半截身子爬出浅坑。
lines.en: I drag half a body out of the shallow pit.

lines.zh: 哪里都能长出我这种东西。
lines.en: Something like me can grow anywhere.

lines.zh: 我在路边的尸堆里动起来。
lines.en: I stir in the corpse pile by the road.

lines.zh: 我这两条胳膊，爬不快了。
lines.en: With these two arms, I can't crawl fast.
Water pours down my throat; I crawl on.

lines.zh: 我趴着爬，箭还是找到了我。
lines.en: I crawl low, and the arrow still finds me.

lines.zh: 符文的火，烧进我的骨头。
lines.en: Rune fire burns down into my bones.

lines.zh: 雷落下来，我的皮在冒烟。
这里没有地面，我抓不住。
lines.en: There is no ground here for me to grip.
